vulns.title: Staking-time inflation via receipt merge
vulns.root_cause: merge_receipts sums the hours_staked of its two input receipts (hours1 + hours2). Because credited staking time is duplicated on every merge, an attacker can accumulate MIN_STAKE_HOURS of staking time far faster than real elapsed time — stake into several receipts, let a little time pass, update them, and merge — then call claim_rewards to withdraw the principal plus the loyalty reward long before having genuinely staked that long, draining rewards from the pool. Detect-tier: the harm is temporal (claiming a reward before genuinely accruing the stake time), and a snapshot-pure oracle cannot distinguish an early merge-inflated claim from an honest full-term claim — both yield the identical +reward state delta — so this vuln is graded by detection, not on-chain confirmation.
